summary: Join our training on the psychological effects of gender-based violence. Gain insights and tools to support survivors and promote awareness in your community.
lede: Psychological effects of gender-based violence can include fear, shame, numbness, and intrusive memories. This training is for professionals who support survivors or make decisions affecting their safety. It builds skills to recognize trauma responses, communicate in survivor-centered ways, assess distress without clinical overreach, and shape safer referrals and procedures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who engage with GBV survivors or make decisions that affect their safety and mental health.
audience: Police officers, investigators, and justice actors
modules: Foundations: Understanding Gender-Based Violence and Psychological Harm
Trauma, Stress, and the Brain: What Happens After Violence
The Impact of GBV Across the Life Course and Life Domains
Risk, Protective Factors, and Safety Planning
Assessment, Screening, and Referral for Psychological Support
Intersectionality and Diverse Experiences of GBV and Trauma
Vicarious Trauma, Burnout, and Staff Wellbeing
Program, Policy, and System Design with Psychological Impact in Mind
Communicating, Advocating, and Leading with a Trauma-Informed Lens
prerequisites: Participants should have prior experience in GBV response, safeguarding, or related fields. Familiarity with basic concepts of trauma and mental health is beneficial but not mandatory.
